title: PlainPairs: software and documents for a research corpus pairing the prescriber and patient texts of US medicine labels
description: The software that builds PlainPairs, a research record of how United States medicine labels are worded for prescribers and for patients, with its documents (method, schema, codebook, data card, sources). This archive holds the code and documents only, no data table. The corpus itself is published on Hugging Face (obadakr/plainpairs), with a mirror on Kaggle (obadakraishan/plainpairs). It is not medical information: never use it to decide anything about a medicine.
